test_title: PYST 25: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A tower stands vertically on the ground. From a point on the ground which is 27.6 m away from the foot of the tower, the angle of elevation of the top of the tower is found to be 45°. Find the height of the tower.
solution:
**Given:**

Distance from the point to the foot of the tower = 27.6 m

Angle of elevation = 45º

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = Opposite Side (Height of the Tower) / Adjacent Side (Distance from the point to the foot)

**Calculation:**

tan 45º = Height of the Tower / 27.6

⇒ 1 = Height of the Tower / 27.6

⇒ Height of the Tower = 1 × 27.6

⇒ Height of the Tower = 27.6 m

**The height of the tower is 27.6 m.**
